senses.gloss:
cakrá, n.
 —1. wheel; chariot-wheel, wagon-wheel;
 —2. by synecdoche, wagon, in pīṭhacakra.
[prob. reduplicated form, ca-kra,
fr. √*kṛ or *kḷ, ‘roll,’ cf. κυλίω, ‘roll’: w.
ca-krá, cf. κύ-κλος, *κϝε-κλος, AS. hweohl,
hweōl, Eng. wheel.]

cákṣas,
 —1. perhaps adj. beholding, see
1296^3 end;
 —2. n. look; eye. [√cakṣ.]
